scope: Post-hoc analytic coverage diagnosis of four chosen colors, not a training-cause or generalization proof. No training or sampling-default change.
tint_definition: 50% neutral; otherwise three independent uniform[0.3,1.5] tints, common scalar intensity and ramp, then clipping. Direct input linear-sRGB channel ratio cannot exceed5. Geometry/positive common PSFs do not enlarge that cone. This is a statement about the procedural smooth branch, not all photo/native/paired/shapes training.
limitation: Palette chosen after the fabric failure; only4 colors, fixed camera transform. Other training domains can contain these hues, and camera transformation/reconstruction has separate behavior. This correlation does not identify why the late checkpoint errs. A future color-coverage treatment needs matched trained controls, color/flat/detail and full photographic/real review.
